official_definition: Target one of your Spirits. Put any number of cores from it to this Spirit. If core is put during Your Attack Step, during this turn, give all your "Red Cloud" family Spirits +1000 BP.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Re Awaken] or [Re Awaken: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Re Awaken]", "give [Re Awaken]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
